He gave up the investment world, earned scholarship in studying laws and now works in a small government office.

This time, he faces a bigger problem that can bring the end to the Lunar Surface.
Hal has 2 goals left need to be fulfilled: To the untrod land and find Hagana to start everything over again with her.
